title: Leah’s Big Day
description: Leah is one! Can she roll a ball back?

intro.alt: A cozy room ready for Leah’s first birthday.

notice: A make-believe family adventure with Anna, Sarah and one-year-old Leah. Read and choose, or listen together.
script:
story 2
variable red = false hidden
scene leah-birthday-room
show Anna happy left
show Sarah curious right
show Leah curious center
camera wide cut
I: Leah is one! Mum is here, too.
Anna [happy]: A ball for you, Leah!
Sarah [curious]: Red or blue?
choice ball
option red "A red ball." -> red ; red = true
option blue "A blue ball." -> blue
label red
Sarah [happy]: Red! Like my hat!
goto try
label blue
Sarah [happy]: Blue! Like the sea!
goto try
label try
I: Leah sits on the rug. Anna rolls the ball.
express Leah sad
I: Leah pats it. It does not roll back.
Anna [curious]: Let us help.
choice help
option near "Sit near." -> near
option show "Show her." -> show
label near
react Anna crouch
Anna [happy]: I sit near you. Roll it to me.
goto roll
label show
react Sarah point
Sarah [happy]: See? I roll it. Now you!
goto roll
label roll
express Leah happy
camera listener Leah cut
I: Leah rolls it back! She did it!
Anna [happy]: You can do it now!
camera wide cut
Sarah [happy]: Again?
choice endgame
option more "One more go!" -> more
option hug "Time for a hug." -> hug
label more
I: Anna rolls. Leah rolls. Sarah has a go.
goto colour
label hug
I: Mum sits by Leah. We all hug.
goto colour
label colour
if red == true -> redend else blueend
label redend
Anna [happy]: A red ball. A new game!
goto done
label blueend
Anna [happy]: A blue ball. A new game!
goto done
label done
express Leah proud
Sarah [happy]: One big day for you!
end

Anna.name: Anna

Sarah.name: Sarah
Sarah.provenance: Family-inspired storybook character styling, guided by David’s supplied family watercolor; original animated illustration.

Leah.name: Leah
Leah.provenance: Original storybook illustration of a seated one-year-old; no photograph used.
